Marta: quick note 1: noticed dashboards and SDK snippets still use `requests_per_min`. metrics API now exposes `rps`. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/430

Kevin: yea, docs-ci failed when I tried importing the dashboard sample. error: `Unknown metric slug: requests_per_min`.

Marta: we should do a small migration doc + update snippets and screenshot. keep a server alias for one release if possible.

Raj: I can open a docs PR to replace the slug in `dashboards/kpis.json` and update `snippets/ts/metrics.ts`. will also add a unit test for the snippet parser.

Olivia: also found a broken internal link in the migration guide: `/dashboards/kpis` -> should be `/console/dashboards/kpis`. will update.

Raj: pushing branch `docs/kpi-slug-migration`. commands I ran: 
```bash
git checkout -b docs/kpi-slug-migration
# edit dashboards and snippet files
git add dashboards/kpis.json docs/snippets/ts/metrics.ts docs/migration/kpi-rename.md
git commit -m "docs: rename requests_per_min -> rps; add migration note and tests"
git push origin docs/kpi-slug-migration
```

Docbot: deploy-preview created: https://deploy-preview-430--docs.redwood-inference.com 
CI: lint + snippet extraction queued.

Kevin: screenshot `static/img/console/kpis.png` still shows "Requests / min". we should regenerate after the JSON update so it matches.

Marta: I'll update the image once PR is green. also please add a short changelog entry under Console > KPI rename guidance.

Olivia: drafting the migration snippet now showing both `requests_per_min` -> `rps` and sample query change.

Raj: added `docs/snippets/tests/parse-metrics.test.ts` asserting snippet compiles and slug maps to `rps`.

Docbot: REVIEWERS assigned: Kevin, Olivia. TODO: screenshot, changelog entry. CI: pending tests.

Kevin: LGTM on changes. merge when deploy preview is green and screenshot updated.
